name: upgrade_planner
description:
Ranked dependency upgrade plan — call before upgrading, adding, or auditing any dependency to pick the safest order.

Source 1, the 4DA app's plan (provenance.mode "app_plan"): used whenever the 4DA desktop app's database holds its computed Upgrade Plan. Returns the app's work order, one step per package keyed by the app's item_id: ecosystem, each installed version with its minimum clean target, upgrade_type (patch/minor/major), clears_all_known, the projects holding it (direct/dev), the mechanism (manifest_bump = edit the manifest; lockfile_or_parent_update = the package is only transitive, update the parent or refresh the lockfile, do not add it as a direct dependency; mixed; no_fix), advisory_ids and a verification instruction. Past the plan's expires_at the result says stale: true; it is still the app's plan, recompute it in the app. risk_threshold filters by the app's urgency; max_recommendations limits the steps (default: all); include_dev does not apply.

Source 2, standalone heuristic (provenance.mode "standalone_heuristic"): used only when no app plan is available (no 4DA database, nothing computed yet, or a snapshot from an incompatible app version; the reason is in appPlanUnavailable). A point-in-time plan from local lockfiles plus live registry/OSV lookups: quick wins (patch/minor), breaking changes (major), and transitive CVEs marked waiting_on_upstream. Call vulnerability_scan first for a CVE-aware fallback; without a scan the output says it is CVE-blind.

Privacy: the app plan is read from the local database. The fallback may query public registries and OSV with package names and versions. Neither sends source code.

risk_threshold.description: Only show upgrades at or above this risk level. Default: all.
